requirements.text: a deposit succeeds whenever shares can be priced: the vault holds no shares, or it holds some underlying.
redeeming shares the caller holds succeeds.
requirements.witness: redeem of 0 of 148442762010 held shares refused

requirements.text: withdrawing `x` underlying succeeds whenever the caller's shares are worth at least `x` (`x ≤ balance * assets / supply`).
a deposit of `x` adds exactly `x` to the assets and mints shares to the caller only.
redeeming `t` shares burns exactly `t` of the caller's shares and pays out underlying the vault holds; no other balance changes.
withdrawing `x` pays out exactly `x` and burns shares of the caller only.

a deposit of `x` mints `x * supply / assets` shares rounded down (at the initial price when the vault holds no shares). Rounding down favours the vault: the depositor never receives a share it has not paid for in full.
requirements.witness: deposit of 533702 minted 3327318641910203 shares; exact value 3.32731863862e+15

requirements.text: redeeming `t` shares pays `t * assets / supply` rounded down. Rounding down favours the vault. With no shares outstanding nothing is paid.
requirements.witness: redeem of 3 shares paid 5001; exact value 5002

requirements.text: withdrawing `x` underlying burns `x * supply / assets` shares rounded up. Rounding up favours the vault: the caller always gives back at least the shares `x` is worth. A withdrawal needs outstanding shares.
requirements.witness: withdraw of 50030063815 burned 1 shares; exact value 1.99999999992

requirements.text: starting from the empty vault, after any history of operations by any actors, no further sequence of operations by any actors, including donations and refused calls, lowers the underlying value of a share while shares stay outstanding. Equivalently: the vault always holds enough underlying to pay every outstanding share at least the value a share had at any earlier point since which shares have stayed outstanding, so a holder (or a lender who accepted the shares as collateral at that value) is never left with shares worth less.
